sentences.Jeg er renholder og jobber på en stor sk: I am a cleaner and work at a big school.
sentences.Kollegaene mine og jeg vasker skolen hve: My colleagues and I clean the school every day.
sentences.Det er mye å gjøre fordi det er mange el: There is a lot to do because there are lots of pupils at the school.
sentences.Når det er dårlig vær ute, blir det skit: When the weather is bad outside, the floor gets dirty.
When there is snow outside, it gets wet inside.
sentences.Det er tungt å være renholder, men det e: Being a cleaner is hard work, but keeping the school clean is important work.
sentences.Lærerne og elevene er glade når klassero: The teachers and pupils are happy when the classrooms are nice and clean.
sentences.Vi må vaske toalettene nøye fordi det er: We have to clean the toilets carefully because good hygiene is important.
sentences.Noen ganger roter barna på toalettet, og: Sometimes the children make a mess in the toilets, and I don't like that.
sentences.For tre år siden tok jeg fagbrev som ren: Three years ago I took my trade certificate as a cleaner.
sentences.Når man har fagbrev, får man bedre lønn,: When you have a trade certificate, you get better pay, and it is easier to get a job.
